scene_brief: Outside a white-marble Indian temple during the family visit after their return to the US; do not identify a specific real temple. Wide shallow temple steps, modest floral/peacock reliefs and a clearly carved WHITE STONE guardian lion on a low pedestal. It is visibly immobile sculpted marble, not a living lion. Neet stands below it on four fine paws, neck stretched up, ears alert and mouth barely open in alarm at the stone animal. Buddy stands alongside but separated, body in readable threequarter side profile, looking calmly toward Neet rather than sharing the alarm. Both dogs on the same lower landing, with no paw raised into a human pointing hand. The foreground lion sculpture and dogs are primary; a second small distant stone guardian can establish the source plural without crowding. No humans, food, text or extra animals. Comedy is disproportionate literal reading of a completely still architectural carving.
placement_after: Neet gasped. "Symbolic?! I thought this was a warning! Like beware, real lions ahead!"
alt_text: Neet mistakes a carved marble guardian for a warning about real lions while Buddy remains unimpressed.
